remarks: Discover the exceptional potential of 16 Hill St, a versatile two-family home located in the heart of Norwalk. Positioned for lifestyle and convenience, this property is less than a minute from I-95, just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, and a stone's throw from the Norwalk River Valley Trail (literally under 500 feet from front door), offering outdoor recreation right at your doorstep. Enjoy proximity to shopping and dining options within half a mile, and take advantage of the vibrant entertainment and retail experiences at SONO Collection and SONO, less than 2 miles away. Currently with low rents, this property holds significant income potential, whether through increased rents or exploring the zoning opportunities to add additional units or even convert the garage to living space. Perfect for investors or homeowners seeking income generation, this large two-family home is brimming with opportunity. Make the most of this rare find in Norwalk--imagine the possibilities and unlock its full potential today!
